name: Form Connectors – Automate Workflows with 350+ Platform Integrations, No-Code
author: Plugcrux

sections.description:
One Plugin – Endless Integrations

Form Connectors is the ultimate no-code automation plugin for WordPress. Seamlessly connect any Contact Form or WooCommerce store with HubSpot, Zoho, Google, Freshsales, Mailchimp, MailerLite, Moosend, Pabbly, SendGrid, Brevo, Twilio, and more platforms.

Automate your CRM updates, email marketing, lead management, and workflows effortlessly — without writing a single line of code.

Whether you’re managing form submissions, syncing WooCommerce orders, or sending leads to your favorite CRM or email tool, Form Connectors makes it fast, reliable, and simple.

Supported Plugins

  • ARForms
  • Contact Form 7
  • Elementor Forms
  • Everest Forms
  • Fluent Forms
  • Formidable Forms
  • Forminator Forms
  • Gravity Forms
  • HappyForms
  • JetFormBuilder
  • Kali Forms
  • MetForm
  • NEX-Forms
  • Ninja Forms
  • SureForms
  • weForms
  • WooCommerce
  • WordPress Core
  • WPForms
  • WSForm

Supported Services

  • Brevo (Sendinblue)
  • Freshsales
  • Google Calendar
  • Google Contacts
  • Google Sheets
  • HubSpot CRM
  • Mailchimp
  • MailerLite
  • Moosend
  • Pabbly Connect
  • SendGrid
  • Twilio SMS
  • Zoho Bigin
  • Zoho Campaigns
  • Zoho CRM
  • Zoho Desk
  • Zoho Sheet

Connect Service

  • Go to the Setup page in the plugin.
  • On the left side, click Select Plugin. A popup will appear where you can choose the plugin you want to integrate.
  • On the right side, click Select Product. A popup will appear where you can select the product or service you want to connect.
  • After selecting both, click Save and Next to continue.

Sign In / Authenticate

  • This step opens automatically after completing Connect Service.
  • Based on your selected product, input fields will appear.
  • Enter a meaningful account name (for example: Main Zoho CRM Account).
  • Follow the notes shown on the screen.
  • Click Authenticate to connect your account.
  • After authentication, you can create and manage multiple connected accounts.

Map Fields

  • This section opens automatically after completing Sign In / Authenticate.
  • Select your form name or, if using WooCommerce, select the event.
  • Depending on the selected product, choose the related list (for email tools) or module (for CRMs).
  • Click Save and Next to open the field mapping area.
  • On the left side, your plugin fields will appear; on the right side, your service fields will appear.
  • Map your form fields to the matching service fields.
  • Choose the Add or Update option if needed.
  • Use the Filter Criteria section to apply conditions (for example: sync only if a checkbox is selected).
  • Click Save Mapping to finish the setup.

Logs

  • Go to the Logs page to view all integration activities. You’ll see a list of submissions with their status and message details.
  • Status types include: SUCCESS – record created successfully, and RECORD_FAILED – sync failed (for example, missing required fields).
  • You can Resync, Delete, or perform bulk actions on selected records.
  • Use filters such as Integration, Status, and Time Range to narrow down the results.
  • Click the Log Details icon to view complete error details, form data, and API responses.

Settings

  • Go to the Settings page to manage global plugin preferences.

  • There are three tabs available: General, Notifications, and Accounts.

  • In General

    • Enable Delete Data on Uninstall to remove all plugin data when the plugin is deleted.
    • Manage log cleanup by enabling or disabling automatic deletion after a set number of days.
    • Click Save Settings to apply changes.

  • In Notifications

    • Enable Error Email Notification to receive alerts when records fail to sync.
    • Enter one or more Email Addresses (comma-separated) to receive notifications.
    • Set a Subject Line for the notification emails (for example: Zoho CRM Sync Error).
    • Click Save Settings to apply changes.

  • In Accounts

    • View all previously connected accounts used in your integrations.
    • You can rename or Re-authenticate any account when needed.

Upgrade to Pro

Unlock the full power of the integration plugin with the Premium Version.

The free version helps you get started quickly, while the premium upgrade offers advanced tools, unlimited connections, and deeper automation — ideal for businesses and professional users.

Free Version Includes:
– Unlimited integrations
– Supports Contact Form 7, WPForms, Elementor Forms, WordPress, and WooCommerce
– Add-only record actions
– Custom values and system field mapping
– Log resync for failed records
– Error notifications
– No submission limits

Premium Version Adds:
– All major form plugins supported
– Add or update record actions
– Custom modules support
– Custom and premium fields mapping
– File attachments
– Tagging and notes
– Advanced conditional filters
– Enhanced log management and reporting
– Unlimited connections and accounts

👉 Upgrade Now: Upgrade to Premium

Features Overview

  • Easy setup with a step-by-step integration wizard
  • Supports all major WordPress form plugins and WooCommerce
  • Real-time syncing of form submissions to connected CRMs, email tools, and Google services
  • Advanced field mapping with support for custom and system fields
  • Conditional logic to control when records are created or updated
  • Detailed activity logs with error handling and resync options
  • GDPR-compliant data handling and secure OAuth 2.0 authentication
  • Email notifications for integration or sync errors
  • Manage multiple accounts and integrations easily
  • Unlimited form connections and automation workflows

Benefits

  • Boost Efficiency: Automate data transfer between your WordPress site and 350+ business platforms
  • Save Time: Reduce manual entry by syncing form submissions instantly to CRMs, Sheets, and marketing tools
  • Stay Organized: Keep customer data consistent across all connected platforms
  • Improve Accuracy: Map form fields precisely to CRM or service fields
  • Stay Secure: All authentication handled through OAuth with GDPR-compliant data flow

Who Should Use This Plugin?

  • Website owners who want to connect WordPress forms to CRMs or email platforms
  • Agencies managing multiple client integrations and workflows
  • eCommerce stores using WooCommerce and CRMs for order or lead tracking
  • Marketers automating lead capture, campaigns, and email flows
  • Developers who want to build custom or multi-step automation between WordPress and external apps

Roadmap

  • Integration with more CRMs and automation tools
  • Webhook support for custom connections
  • Enhanced reporting and analytics dashboard
  • Multi-step and conditional workflows
  • AI-based lead scoring and response suggestions
  • Multilingual support and advanced logging features

Privacy & GDPR

  • No personal data is stored locally. All data is securely transferred through each platform’s API.
  • All authentication is handled via OAuth 2.0, ensuring secure and compliant communication between WordPress and third-party services.

Support

Need help or have a feature request?

  • Contact Support
  • Feature Request

Website: https://integrazo.com/
Email: support@integrazo.com

Additional Notes

This plugin is compatible with WordPress multisite installations. Tested rigorously to ensure reliable and efficient CRM integrations.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation
1. Go to Plugins → Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
2. In the search bar, type Integrazo and locate this plugin.
3. Click Install and then Activate.

Manual Installation
1. Upload the plugin ZIP file via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
2. Activate the plugin.
3. Go to the plugin settings and complete the setup.
sections.faq:
Which WordPress forms does this plugin support?

This plugin supports integration with 350+ platforms using the following WordPress form plugins and WooCommerce:

  • ARForms – Automate ARForms data transfer to CRMs, Google, and email marketing tools.
  • Contact Form 7 – Connect Contact Form 7 with CRMs, email tools, and Google services for seamless lead capture and automation.
  • Elementor Forms – Integrate Elementor form submissions with CRMs, Sheets, and email platforms in real time.
  • Everest Forms – Transfer Everest Forms data to Google Sheets, Zoho, HubSpot, or any supported tool.
  • Fluent Forms – Sync Fluent Forms submissions with your CRM, email tools, or spreadsheets.
  • Formidable Forms – Automate Formidable Form submissions with CRMs, Google, or Mail services.
  • Forminator Forms – Connect Forminator with CRMs, email systems, and workflow automation tools.
  • Gravity Forms – Connect Gravity Forms with Zoho, Google Sheets, HubSpot, and other automation services.
  • HappyForms – Sync HappyForms data with CRM and email automation platforms.
  • JetFormBuilder – Send JetFormBuilder submissions to HubSpot, Google Sheets, or Zoho CRM.
  • Kali Forms – Integrate Kali Forms with Zoho CRM, HubSpot, Google Sheets, or email services.
  • MetForm – Automate MetForm entries with Zoho CRM, Mailchimp, and Google integrations.
  • NEX-Forms – Send NEX-Forms submissions to Zoho CRM, Mailchimp, and other supported tools.
  • Ninja Forms – Send Ninja Forms leads directly to CRM or email marketing platforms.
  • SureForms – Integrate SureForms with marketing tools and CRMs to simplify workflows.
  • weForms – Connect weForms submissions directly to CRMs and Google tools automatically.
  • WooCommerce – Sync WooCommerce customer and order data with CRM and marketing tools effortlessly.
  • WordPress Core – Automate WordPress user data and site actions with your favorite CRMs or automation tools.
  • WPForms – Send WPForms entries to HubSpot, Zoho, Mailchimp, and 300+ other apps automatically.
  • WSForm – Map WSForm fields to CRM or marketing platforms with real-time automation.

Need support for another form plugin? Submit a request on our Feature Request page.

Which CRM, Email, and Automation tools does this plugin support?

This plugin connects WordPress forms and WooCommerce with 350+ services to automate workflows, sync leads, and simplify business processes.

  • Brevo (Sendinblue) – Connect forms with Brevo to send emails, manage campaigns, and grow your subscriber list.
  • Freshsales – Automate lead creation and sales tracking between WordPress and Freshsales CRM.
  • Google Calendar – Automatically create and manage Google Calendar events from form submissions.
  • Google Contacts – Sync new form entries or WooCommerce customers as Google Contacts.
  • Google Sheets – Save form and order data directly to Google Sheets for reporting and analytics.
  • HubSpot CRM – Send leads, contacts, and form submissions directly to HubSpot CRM.
  • Mailchimp – Add subscribers to Mailchimp lists automatically from any WordPress form.
  • MailerLite – Integrate forms with MailerLite to grow your email marketing campaigns.
  • Moosend – Connect WordPress forms with Moosend for newsletter automation and subscriber management.
  • Pabbly Connect – Automate workflows between WordPress and 1000+ apps through Pabbly Connect.
  • SendGrid – Send email notifications or store contact data directly to SendGrid lists.
  • Twilio SMS – Send automated SMS alerts and notifications from WordPress forms or WooCommerce.
  • Zoho Bigin – Sync form leads and customer data with Zoho Bigin pipelines and contacts.
  • Zoho Campaigns – Add form subscribers directly to Zoho Campaigns mailing lists.
  • Zoho CRM – Automate contact, lead, and deal creation between WordPress and Zoho CRM.
  • Zoho Desk – Create or update Zoho Desk tickets from form submissions or WooCommerce orders.
  • Zoho Sheet – Store form data and WooCommerce order details inside Zoho Sheet for analysis.

Need integration with another platform? Submit your request on our Feature Request page.

Can I connect my WordPress forms and WooCommerce store to CRMs like Zoho and HubSpot?

Yes. Form Connectors seamlessly integrates WordPress forms such as Contact Form 7, WPForms, Elementor Forms, Gravity Forms, and WooCommerce with Zoho CRM, HubSpot CRM, Freshsales, and more.
You can automatically create or update leads, contacts, and deals when a visitor submits a form or completes a purchase — no manual entry required.

Does this plugin support Google and Email marketing tools?

Absolutely. You can connect your forms and WooCommerce checkout with Google Sheets, Google Contacts, and Google Calendar for instant data syncing.
It also integrates with Mailchimp, MailerLite, Moosend, Brevo (Sendinblue), SendGrid, and Pabbly Connect to automate email campaigns, subscriber lists, and workflow actions.

Can I send form submissions to multiple platforms at once?

Yes. Form Connectors allows multi-integration automation — for example, send the same form data to Zoho CRM for lead capture, Google Sheets for record keeping, and Mailchimp for email marketing simultaneously.
You can set up unlimited connections and manage them all from one dashboard.

How secure is the connection between WordPress and external apps?

All integrations use secure OAuth 2.0 authentication, and no sensitive data such as API keys or passwords are stored on your WordPress site.
The plugin is fully GDPR-compliant and transmits data safely through each platform’s verified API.

Who can benefit most from using Form Connectors?

Form Connectors is ideal for business owners, agencies, marketers, and eCommerce stores that rely on CRMs, Google Workspace, or marketing tools.
It helps you automate workflows, save time, reduce manual tasks, and keep your customer data perfectly in sync across all connected platforms.

Can I disable specific integrations temporarily?

Yes, you can toggle the integration status on the Setup page. Turn it off anytime without deleting the mapping. You can re-enable it later when needed.
